name: SetDimensionValues
caption: Set Dimension Values

configuration.description: SmartField reference to the record, written as exactly one placeholder in double braces, e.g. "{{trigger_Rec}}" or "{{FindCustomers_results}}". An undotted name is looked up directly (an array reference such as {{FindX_results}} resolves to its first element); a dotted path (e.g. {{trigger_Rec.Customer}}) is walked through the SmartField definitions. Surrounding whitespace is ignored. Anything else fails at runtime. The table must have a 'Dimension Set ID' field.
Table number of the referenced record. The editor derives it from the reference; it must match the resolved record at runtime.
Run Triggers. true (default when absent) = BC standard OnModify(true): the table's OnModify trigger and its subscribers run; false = OnModify(false). Non-boolean values fall back to the default.

One row per dimension to change, processed in array order (if a code is listed twice, the last row wins). Listed dimensions are added or updated, a row with an empty value removes that dimension, unlisted dimensions are kept.

items.description: Dimension code (e.g. 'DEPARTMENT'). Trimmed and upper-cased; rows with an empty code are skipped.

Dimension value code: a literal or SmartText with {{…}} placeholders. Resolved, then trimmed; the result must be an existing value code of that dimension (max 20 characters). Empty = remove the dimension from the set.
Written by the config canvas on repeater rows (10000, 20000, …); ignored by this step.

outputs.name: dimensionSetId
outputs.when: always - the new Dimension Set ID as text

rules.check: configuration.reference must be non-empty (required field in the config canvas).
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: configuration.reference must be a single SmartField placeholder: after trimming it starts with '{{', ends with '}}' and has a non-empty name inside. Otherwise it cannot be resolved.

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be present and non-zero (missing, null or unreadable values count as 0). The editor derives it from the reference.

rules.check: The reference must resolve to a record reference in the flow context at run time, and the record must still exist (otherwise Business Central's standard 'record does not exist' error).
rules.message: Reference "%1" cannot be resolved to a record.

rules.check: dimensions should be a JSON array; other types are ignored (set unchanged).

notes: Global/Shortcut Dimension 1 and 2 code fields on the record are kept in sync with the new set (assigned directly, without validation).
The record is saved with Modify(triggers). Only the referenced record changes: changing a document header's dimensions does not update its lines.
Writing step: a Confirm dialog placed after this step (in document order) gets a publish warning, because Business Central cannot open a dialog once the flow has written to the database.
